sections.label: Book 6
sections.name: The sacrificial stake and victim; the Soma pressing

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे नार्यसीदमहं रक्षसां ग्रीवा अपि कृन्तामि। यवोऽसि यवयास्मद् द्वेषो यवयारातीर्दिवे त्वाऽन्तरिक्षाय त्वा पृथिव्यै त्वा शुन्धन्ताँल्लोकाः पितृषदनाः। पितृषदनमसि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade nāryasīdamahaṃ rakṣasāṃ grīvā api kṛntāmi yavo'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātīrdive tvā'ntarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā śundhantāṃllokāḥ pitṛṣadanāḥ pitṛṣadanamasi
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of A$vins, with the hands of PAshan. Thou art a woman. Here I cut the necks of Rakshasas away. Barley. art thou. Bar off from us our haters, bar our enemies. Thee for heaven, thee for earth, thee for the welkin. Pure be the worlds, the Fathers' dwelling-places. Thou art the habitation of the Fathers.

verses.sa: अग्रेणीरसि स्वावेश उन्नेतॄणामेतस्य वित्तादधि त्वा स्थास्यति देवस्त्वा सविता मध्वानक्तु सुपिप्पलाभ्यस्त्वौषधीभ्यः। द्यामग्रेणास्पृक्ष आन्तरिक्षं मध्येनाप्राः पृथिवीमुपरेणादृंहीः॥
verses.tr: agreṇīrasi svāveśa unnetṝṇāmetasya vittādadhi tvā sthāsyati devastvā savitā madhvānaktu supippalābhyastvauṣadhībhyaḥ dyāmagreṇāspṛkṣa āntarikṣaṃ madhyenāprāḥ pṛthivīmupareṇādṛṃhīḥ
verses.en: Thou art a leader, easy, to Unnetars, of access. Know this. It will stand upon thee. Savitar, God, anoint thee with sweet butter. Thee for the plants laden with goodly fruitage! Thou with thy top hast touched the sky, hast with thy middle filled the air, and steadied with thy base the earth.

verses.sa: या ते धामान्युश्मसि गमध्यै यत्र गावो भूरिशृङ्गा अयासः। अत्राह तदुरुगायस्य विष्णोः परमं पदमव भारि भूरि। ब्रह्मवनि त्वा क्षत्रवनि रायस्पोषवनि पर्यूहामि। ब्रह्म दृंह क्षत्रं दृंहायुर्दृंह प्रजां दृंह॥
verses.tr: yā te dhāmānyuśmasi gamadhyai yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṅgā ayāsaḥ atrāha tadurugāyasya viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padamava bhāri bhūri brahmavani tvā kṣatravani rāyaspoṣavani paryūhāmi brahma dṛṃha kṣatraṃ dṛṃhāyurdṛṃha prajāṃ dṛṃha
verses.en: Those seats of thine which we desire to visit, where there are many-horned and nimble oxen, There, of a truth, was mightily imprinted the loftiest step of widely-striding Vishnu. I close thee in, the winner of the BrAhmans, winner of Nobles and abundant riches. Strengthen the BrAhmans, strengthen thou the Nobles, strengthen our vital power, strengthen our offspring.

verses.sa: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे। इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा॥
verses.tr: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
verses.en: Look ye on Vishnu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sa: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयो। दिवीव चक्षुराततम्॥
verses.tr: tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyanti sūrayo divīva cakṣurātatam
verses.en: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishnu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.

verses.sa: परिवीरसि परि त्वा दैवीर्विशो व्ययन्तां परीमं यजमानं रायो मनुष्याणाम्। दिवः सूनुरस्येष ते पृथिव्याँल्लोक आरण्यस्ते पशुः॥
verses.tr: parivīrasi pari tvā daivīrviśo vyayantāṃ parīmaṃ yajamānaṃ rāyo manuṣyāṇām divaḥ sūnurasyeṣa te pṛthivyāṃlloka āraṇyaste paśuḥ
verses.en: Thou art invested. Heavenly hosts invest thee! Riches of men invest this Sacriticer! Heaven's son art thou. This is thine earthly station. Thine is the beast whose home is in the forest.

verses.sa: उपावीरस्युप देवान्दैवीर्विशः प्रागुरुशिजो वह्नितमान्। देव त्वष्टर्वसु रम हव्या ते स्वदन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: upāvīrasyupa devāndaivīrviśaḥ prāguruśijo vahnitamān deva tvaṣṭarvasu rama havyā te svadantām
verses.en: Encourager art thou. The hosts of heaven have come to yearning. Gods, the best conductors. God Tvashtar, make the wealth of cattle quiet. Delightful to the taste be thine oblations.

verses.sa: रेवती रमध्वं बृहस्पते धारया वसूनि। ऋतस्य त्वा देवहविः पाशेन प्रति मुञ्चामि धर्षा मानुषः॥
verses.tr: revatī ramadhvaṃ bṛhaspate dhārayā vasūni ṛtasya tvā devahaviḥ pāśena prati muñcāmi dharṣā mānuṣaḥ
verses.en: Joy, wealthy ones! Brihaspati, save our riches. I bind thee with the noose of holy Order, thou offering to the Gods. Held be the Slayer.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। अग्नीषोमाभ्यां जुष्टं नि युनज्मि। अद्भ्यस्त्वौषधीभ्योऽनु त्वा माता मन्यतामनु पिताऽनु भ्राता सगर्भ्योऽनु सखा सयूथ्यः। अग्नीषोमाभ्यां त्वा जुष्टं प्रोक्षामि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām agnīṣomābhyāṃ juṣṭaṃ ni yunajmi adbhyastvauṣadhībhyo'nu tvā mātā manyatāmanu pitā'nu bhrātā sagarbhyo'nu sakhā sayūthyaḥ agnīṣomābhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi
verses.en: By: impulse of God Savitar I bind thee, with arms of Asvins and with hands of PAshan, thee welcome unto Agni and to Soma. Thee for the waters, thee for plants. Thy mother grant thee permission, and thy father, brother born of one dam, thy friend, thy herd-companion. I sprinkle thee welcome to Agni-Soma.

verses.sa: अपां पेरुरस्यापो देवीः स्वदन्तु स्वात्तं चित्सद्देवहविः। सं ते प्राणो वातेन गच्छतांसमङ्गानि यजत्रैः सं यज्ञपतिराशिषा॥
verses.tr: apāṃ perurasyāpo devīḥ svadantu svāttaṃ citsaddevahaviḥ saṃ te prāṇo vātena gacchatāṃsamaṅgāni yajatraiḥ saṃ yajñapatirāśiṣā
verses.en: Drinker art thou of water. May the Waters, the Goddesses, add 'sweetness to the oblation prepared for Gods, even though already sweetened. Thy breath join wind, thy limbs those meet for worship, the sacrifice's lord the boon he prays for.

verses.sa: घृतेनाक्तौ पशूँस्त्रायेथां रेवति यजमाने प्रियं धा आ विश। उरोरन्तरिक्षात्सजूर्देवेन वातेनास्य हविषस्त्मना यज समस्य तन्वा भव। वर्षो वर्षीयसि यज्ञे यज्ञपतिं धाः स्वाहा देवेभ्यो देवेभ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ghṛtenāktau paśūṃstrāyethāṃ revati yajamāne priyaṃ dhā ā viśa urorantarikṣātsajūrdevena vātenāsya haviṣastmanā yaja samasya tanvā bhava varṣo varṣīyasi yajñe yajñapatiṃ dhāḥ svāhā devebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Balmed, both of you, with butter, guard the cattle. Grant, Rich! the Sacrificer's prayer. Approach thou. Meeting with heavenly Wind, from air's mid-region. Be thou united with this offering's body. O Great One, lead the sacrifice's master on to a sacrifice of loftier order. All-hail to Gods! To Gods All-hail! I

verses.sa: माहिर्भूर्मा पृदाकुर्नमस्त आतानानर्वा प्रेहि। घृतस्य कुल्या उप ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु॥
verses.tr: māhirbhūrmā pṛdākurnamasta ātānānarvā prehi ghṛtasya kulyā upa ṛtasya pathyā anu
verses.en: Become no serpent, thou, become no viper. To thee, O widely-spread, be adoration. Advance, unhindered, on thy way. To rivers of butter move along the paths of Order.

verses.sa: देवीरापः शुद्धा वोढ्वं सुपरिविष्टा देवेषु सुपरिविष्टा वयं परिवेष्टारो भूयास्म॥
verses.tr: devīrāpaḥ śuddhā voḍhvaṃ supariviṣṭā deveṣu supariviṣṭā vayaṃ pariveṣṭāro bhūyāsma
verses.en: Bear the oblation to the Gods, ye Waters celestial and pure and well provided. May we become providers well-provided.

verses.sa: वाचं ते शुन्धामि प्राणं ते शुन्धामि चक्षुस्ते शुन्धामि श्रोत्रं ते शुन्धामि नाभिं ते शुन्धामि मेढ्रं ते शुन्धामि पायुं ते शुन्धामि चरित्राँस्ते शुन्धामि॥
verses.tr: vācaṃ te śundhāmi prāṇaṃ te śundhāmi cakṣuste śundhāmi śrotraṃ te śundhāmi nābhiṃ te śundhāmi meḍhraṃ te śundhāmi pāyuṃ te śundhāmi caritrāṃste śundhāmi
verses.en: I cleanse thy voice, thy breath, thine eye, thine ear, thy navel, and thy feet, thy sexual organ, and thy rump.

verses.sa: मनस्त आ प्यायतां वाक्त आ प्यायतां प्राणस्त आ प्यायतां चक्षुस्त आ प्यायतांं श्रोत्रं त आ प्यायताम्। यत्ते क्रूरं यदास्थितं तत्त आ प्यायतां निष्ट्यायतां तत्ते शुध्यतु शमहोभ्यः। ओषधे त्रायस्व स्वधिते मैनं हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: manasta ā pyāyatāṃ vākta ā pyāyatāṃ prāṇasta ā pyāyatāṃ cakṣusta ā pyāyatāṃṃ śrotraṃ ta ā pyāyatām yatte krūraṃ yadāsthitaṃ tatta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭyāyatāṃ tatte śudhyatu śamahobhyaḥ oṣadhe trāyasva svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: Let thy mind, voice, and breath increase in fulness, thine eye be fuller, and thine ear grow stronger. Whatever there is in thee sore or wounded, may that be filled for thee, cleansed and united. Blest be the days. Plant, guard! Axe, do not harm him.

verses.sa: रक्षसां भागोऽसि निरस्तं रक्ष इदमहं रक्षोऽभि तिष्ठामीदमहं रक्षोऽव बाध इदमहं रक्षोऽधमं तमो नयामि। घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी प्रोर्णुवाथां वायो वे स्तोकानामग्निराज्यस्य वेतु स्वाहा स्वाहाकृते ऊर्ध्वनभसं मारुतं गच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: rakṣasāṃ bhāgo'si nirastaṃ rakṣa idamahaṃ rakṣo'bhi tiṣṭhāmīdamahaṃ rakṣo'va bādha idamahaṃ rakṣo'dhamaṃ tamo nayāmi ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī prorṇuvāthāṃ vāyo ve stokānāmagnirājyasya vetu svāhā svāhākṛte ūrdhvanabhasaṃ mārutaṃ gacchatam
verses.en: Thou art the demons' share. Expelled are demons. Here! I tread down; here I repel the demons; here lead the demons into lowest darkness. Invest, ye two, the heaven and earth with fatness. O Vlyu, eagerly enjoy the droppings. Let Agni eagerly enjoy the butter. All hail! Go, both of you, by Svah& consecrated, to Ordhvaoabhas, offspring of the Maruts.

verses.sa: इदमापः प्र वहतावद्यं च मलं च यत्। यच्चाभिदुद्रोहानृतं यच्च शेपे अभीरुणम्। आपो मा तस्मादेनसः पवमानश्च मुञ्चतु॥
verses.tr: idamāpaḥ pra vahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat yaccābhidudrohānṛtaṃ yacca śepe abhīruṇam āpo mā tasmādenasaḥ pavamānaśca muñcatu
verses.en: Ye Waters, wash away this stain and whatsoever taint be here, Each sinful act that I have done, and every harmless curse of mine. May Waters rid me of that guilt, and PavamAna set me free.

verses.sa: सं ते मनो मनसा सं प्राणः प्राणेन गच्छताम्। रेडस्यग्निष्ट्वा श्रीणात्वापस्त्वा समरिणन्वातस्य त्वा ध्राज्यै पूष्णो रंह्या ऊष्मणो व्यथिषत् प्रयुतं द्वेषः॥
verses.tr: saṃ te mano manasā saṃ prāṇaḥ prāṇena gacchatām reḍasyagniṣṭvā śrīṇātvāpastvā samariṇanvātasya tvā dhrājyai pūṣṇo raṃhyā ūṣmaṇo vyathiṣat prayutaṃ dveṣaḥ
verses.en: Be they united, with the Mind thy mind, and with the Breath thy breath. Thou quiverest. Let Agni make thee ready. Waters have washed together all thy juices. Thee for the Wind's rush, for the speed of Pilishan. From heated vapour may it reel and totter,—the disconcerted hatred of our foemen.

verses.sa: घृतं घृतपावानः पिबत वसां वसापावानः पिबतान्तरिक्षस्य हविरसि स्वाहा। दिशः प्रदिशः आदिशो विदिश उद्दिशो दिग्भ्यः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ ghṛtapāvānaḥ pibata vasāṃ vasāpāvānaḥ pibatāntarikṣasya havirasi svāhā diśaḥ pradiśaḥ ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo digbhyaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye drinkers-up of fatness, drink the fatness; drink up the gravy, drinkers of the gravy! Thou art the oblation of the air's mid-region. All-hail! I The regions, the fore-regions, the, by-regions, the intermediate and the upper regions,—to all the regions Hail! I

verses.sa: ऐन्द्रः प्राणो अङ्गे अङ्गे नि दीध्यदैन्द्र उदानो अङ्गे अङ्गे निधीतः। देव त्वष्टर्भूरि ते सं समेतु सलक्ष्मा यद्विषुरूपं भवाति। देवत्रा यन्तमवसे सखायोऽनु त्वा माता पितरो मदन्तु॥
verses.tr: aindraḥ prāṇo aṅge aṅge ni dīdhyadaindra udāno aṅge aṅge nidhītaḥ deva tvaṣṭarbhūri te saṃ sametu salakṣmā yadviṣurūpaṃ bhavāti devatrā yantamavase sakhāyo'nu tvā mātā pitaro madantu
verses.en: In every limb is Indra's out-breath seated, in every limb is Indra's in-breath settled. God Tvashtar, let thine ample forms be blended, that what wears different shapes may be one-fashioned. To please thee let thy friends, mother and father, joy over thee as to the Gods thou goest.

verses.sa: समुद्रं गच्छ स्वाहा ऽन्तरिक्षं गच्छ स्वाहा देवं सवितारं गच्छ स्वाहा मित्रावरुणौ गच्छ स्वाहा ऽहोरात्रे गच्छ स्वाहा छन्दांसि गच्छ स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवी गच्छ स्वाहा यज्ञं गच्छ स्वाहा सोमं गच्छ स्वाहा दिव्यं नभो गच्छ स्वाहा ऽग्निं वैश्वानरं गच्छ स्वाहा मनो मे हार्दि यच्छ दिवं ते धूमो गच्छतु स्वर्ज्योतिः पृथिवीं भस्मनाऽऽपृण स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: samudraṃ gaccha svāhā 'ntarikṣaṃ gaccha svāhā devaṃ savitāraṃ gaccha svāhā mitrāvaruṇau gaccha svāhā 'horātre gaccha svāhā chandāṃsi gaccha svāhā dyāvāpṛthivī gaccha svāhā yajñaṃ gaccha svāhā somaṃ gaccha svāhā divyaṃ nabho gaccha svāhā 'gniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ gaccha svāhā mano me hārdi yaccha divaṃ te dhūmo gacchatu svarjyotiḥ pṛthivīṃ bhasmanā''pṛṇa svāhā
verses.en: Go to the sea. All-hail! Go to the air. All-hail! Go to God Savitar. All hail! Go thou to Mitra-Varuna. All-hail! Go thou to Day and Night. All-hail! Go to the Metres. All-hail! Go to Heaven and Earth. All-hail! I Go to the sacrifice. All-hail! Go to Soma. All-hail! Go to the heavenly ether. All-hail! Go to vi-nara Agni. All hail! Bestow upon me mind and heart. Thy smoke mount to the sky, to heaven thy lustre. Fill thou the spacious earth full with thine ashes.

verses.sa: माऽपो मौषधीर्हिंसीर्धाम्नो धाम्नो राजँस्ततो वरुण नो मुञ्च। यदाहुरघ्न्या इति वरुणेति शपामहे ततो वरुण नो मुञ्च। सुमित्रिया न आप ओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु योस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: mā'po mauṣadhīrhiṃsīrdhāmno dhāmno rājaṃstato varuṇa no muñca yadāhuraghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yosmāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: Harm not the Waters, do the Plants no damage. From every place, King Varuna. thence save us. Their saying that we swear our oath by sacred cows, by Vanina, O Varuna, save us therefrom. To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sa: हविष्मतीरिमा आपो हविष्माँ२ आ विवासति। हविष्मान् देवो अध्वरो हविष्माँ२ अस्तु सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: haviṣmatīrimā āpo haviṣmāṃ2 ā vivāsati haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmāṃ2 astu sūryaḥ
verses.en: These waters teem with sacred food: rich in that food, one longs for them. Rich be the holy rite therein. In sacred food be SArya rich.

verses.sa: अग्नेर्वोऽपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामीन्द्राग्न्योर्भागधेयी स्थ मित्रावरुणयोर्भागधेयी स्थ विश्वेषां देवानां भागधेयी स्थ। अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह। ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम्॥
verses.tr: agnervo'pannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmīndrāgnyorbhāgadheyī stha mitrāvaruṇayorbhāgadheyī stha viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūryaḥ saha tā no hinvantvadhvaram
verses.en: I set you down in Agni's seat whose home is indestructible. Indra-and-Agni's share are ye, Mitra-and share are ye. The share of all the Gods are ye. May waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined. Speed on this sacred rite of ours.

verses.sa: हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा दिवे त्वा सूर्याय त्वा। ऊर्ध्वमिममध्वरं दिवि देवेषु होत्रा यच्छ॥
verses.tr: hṛde tvā manase tvā dive tvā sūryāya tvā ūrdhvamimamadhvaraṃ divi deveṣu hotrā yaccha
verses.en: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the heaven, thee for the Sun. Bear up erect to heaven, to Gods, this rite, these sacrificial calls.

verses.sa: सोम राजन् विश्वास्त्वं प्रजा उपावरोह विश्वास्त्वां प्रजा उपावरोहन्तु। शृणोत्वग्निः समिधा हवं मे शृण्वन्त्वापो धिषणाश्च देवीः। श्रोता ग्रावाणो विदुषो न यज्ञं शृणोतु देवः सविता हवं मे स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: soma rājan viśvāstvaṃ prajā upāvaroha viśvāstvāṃ prajā upāvarohantu śṛṇotvagniḥ samidhā havaṃ me śṛṇvantvāpo dhiṣaṇāśca devīḥ śrotā grāvāṇo viduṣo na yajñaṃ śṛṇotu devaḥ savitā havaṃ me svāhā
verses.en: Descend, O Soma, King, to all thy people. Down, unto thee, go, one and all, thy people! May Agni with his fuel hear my calling. Hear it the Waters and.the Bowls, Divine Ones! Hear, Stones, as knowing sacrifice, my calling. May the God Savitar hear mine invocation. All hai!

verses.sa: देवीरापो अपां नपाद्यो व ऊर्मिर्हविष्य इन्द्रियावान् मदिन्तमः। तं देवेभ्यो देवत्रा दत्त शुक्रपेभ्यो येषां भाग स्थ स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: devīrāpo apāṃ napādyo va ūrmirhaviṣya indriyāvān madintamaḥ taṃ devebhyo devatrā datta śukrapebhyo yeṣāṃ bhāga stha svāhā
verses.en: Waters Divine, your wave, the Waters' offspring, fit for oblation, potent, most delightful—Upon those Gods among the Gods bestow it, who drink the pure, of whom ye are the portion. All-hail!

verses.sa: कार्षिरसि समुद्रस्य त्वा क्षित्या उन्नयामि। समापो अद्भिरग्मत समोषधीभिरोषधीः॥
verses.tr: kārṣirasi samudrasya tvā kṣityā unnayāmi samāpo adbhiragmata samoṣadhībhiroṣadhīḥ
verses.en: Drawing art thou: I draw thee up that Ocean ne'er may waste or wane. Let waters with the waters, and the plants commingle with the plants.

verses.sa: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः। स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ svāhā
verses.en: That man is, lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददे रावासि गभीरमिममध्वरं कृधीन्द्राय सुषूतमम्। उत्तमेन पविनोर्जस्वन्तं मधुमन्तं पयस्वन्तं निग्राभ्या स्थ देवश्रुतस्तर्पयत मा॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade rāvāsi gabhīramimamadhvaraṃ kṛdhīndrāya suṣūtamam uttamena pavinorjasvantaṃ madhumantaṃ payasvantaṃ nigrābhyā stha devaśrutastarpayata mā
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of PCtshan. Free with thy gifts art thou. Perform for Indra this deep, most excellently ordered worship. With the most noble bolt I pay the worship enriched with strengthening food and milk and sweetness. Ye are Nigr^bbya& waters, heard by Deities: make me con content.

verses.sa: मनो मे तर्पयत वाचं मे तर्पयत प्राणं मे तर्पयत चक्षुर्मे तर्पयत श्रोत्रं मे तर्पयतात्मानं मे तर्पयत प्रजां मे तर्पयत पशून्मे तर्पयत गणान्मे तर्पयत गणा मे मा वि तृषन्॥
verses.tr: mano me tarpayata vācaṃ me tarpayata prāṇaṃ me tarpayata cakṣurme tarpayata śrotraṃ me tarpayatātmānaṃ me tarpayata prajāṃ me tarpayata paśūnme tarpayata gaṇānme tarpayata gaṇā me mā vi tṛṣan
verses.en: Content my mind, content my speech, content my breath, content mine eye, content mine ear, content my sou, content my progeny, content my herds, con content the troops of men about me: never may the bands of men about me suffer thirst.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय त्वा वसुमते रुद्रवत इन्द्राय त्वा ऽऽदित्यवत इन्द्राय त्वा ऽभिमातिघ्ने। श्येनाय त्वा सोमभृते ऽग्नये त्वा रायस्पोषदे॥
verses.tr: indrāya tvā vasumate rudravata indrāya tvā ''dityavata indrāya tvā 'bhimātighne śyenāya tvā somabhṛte 'gnaye tvā rāyaspoṣade
verses.en: For Indra girt by Vasus and accompanied by Rudras, thee. For Indra with Adityas, thee. For Indra foe- 'ioe-destroyer, thee. Thee for the Soma*bringing Hawk. For plenty Agni, thee.

verses.sa: यत्ते सोम दिवि ज्योतिर्यत्पृथिव्यां यदुरावन्तरिक्षे। तेनास्मै यजमानायोरु राये कृध्यधि दात्रे वोचः॥
verses.tr: yatte soma divi jyotiryatpṛthivyāṃ yadurāvantarikṣe tenāsmai yajamānāyoru rāye kṛdhyadhi dātre vocaḥ
verses.en: Soma, what light there is of thine in heaven, what on the earth, what in mid-air's wide region. Therewith give broad space to the Sacrificer for his enrichment: Comfort thou the giver.

verses.sa: श्वात्रा स्थ वृत्रतुरो राधोगूर्ता अमृतस्य पत्नीः। ता देवीर्देवत्रेमं यज्ञं नयतोपहूताः सोमस्य पिबत॥
verses.tr: śvātrā stha vṛtraturo rādhogūrtā amṛtasya patnīḥ tā devīrdevatremaṃ yajñaṃ nayatopahūtāḥ somasya pibata
verses.en: Auspicious are ye, conquerors of Vritra,. formed for bestowing wealth, the Immortal's Consorts. Lead to the Gods this sacrifice, Divine Ones! and at our invitation drink of Soma.

verses.sa: मा भेर्मा सं विक्था ऊर्जं धत्स्व धिषणे वीड्वी सती वीडयेथामूर्जं दधाथाम्। पाप्मा हतो न सोमः॥
verses.tr: mā bhermā saṃ vikthā ūrjaṃ dhatsva dhiṣaṇe vīḍvī satī vīḍayethāmūrjaṃ dadhāthām pāpmā hato na somaḥ
verses.en: Be not afraid; shake not with terror. T Take thou strength. Ye two Bowls, being firm, stay firm, and take ye strength. Mishap—not Soma—hath been killed.

verses.sa: प्रागपागुदगधराक्सर्वतस्त्वा दिश आ धावन्तु। अम्ब निष्पर समरीर्विदाम्॥
verses.tr: prāgapāgudagadharāksarvatastvā diśa ā dhāvantu amba niṣpara samarīrvidām
verses.en: East, west, north, south, from every side to meet thee let the regions run. Fill him), O Mother, let the noble meet together.

verses.sa: त्वमङ्ग प्रशंसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम्। न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः॥
verses.tr: tvamaṅga praśaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ
verses.en: Thou, verily, O Mightiest, as God shalt gladden mortal man. Bounteous Lord, there is no comforter but thou. Indra, I speak my words to thee.
